_about: Which Windows apps have a Linux version, a web version, run under Wine (Bottles) or Steam's Proton, or have no replacement on OrionOS. Read by os/windows/Check-OrionReady.ps1 and Move-ToOrion.ps1 on Windows, and by os/lab/bin/orion-move-in on OrionOS. 'match' is a list of case-insensitive regular expressions tried against the app's name in Windows' installed-apps list (keep them simple: they run in both PowerShell and Python). 'flatpak' is a Flathub id that was checked against github.com/flathub/<id> on the 'checked' date; never add one that hasn't been checked like that. 'recipe' is an OrionOS install recipe (os/lab/recipes/<name>.sh). 'tool' is an OrionOS command. 'exe' lists program or shortcut names (no .exe) and 'winget' lists winget package ids; Export-ForOrion.ps1 uses both to tell how often you really use each app.

apps.name: Discord

apps.name: Steam
apps.how: Steam has a Linux version. Most Windows games run in it with Proton (turn it on in Steam > Settings > Compatibility).

apps.name: Battle.net
apps.how: Install Battle.net inside Bottles (pick a Gaming bottle) or Lutris. Most Blizzard games run; some need tweaks.

apps.name: Epic Games Launcher
apps.how: Use Heroic Games Launcher: it signs in to Epic and runs your Epic games.

apps.name: GOG Galaxy
apps.how: Use Heroic Games Launcher: it signs in to GOG.

apps.name: EA app
apps.how: Runs inside Bottles or Lutris. Many EA games are also on Steam, where Proton runs them.

apps.name: Ubisoft Connect
apps.how: Runs inside Bottles or Lutris.

apps.name: Riot Client (Valorant, League of Legends)
apps.how: Riot's anti-cheat (Vanguard) doesn't run on Linux. Keep Windows for these games.

apps.name: Fortnite
apps.how: Fortnite's anti-cheat doesn't allow Linux. Keep Windows for it.

apps.name: Roblox
apps.how: Roblox doesn't run on Linux officially. Keep Windows for it.

apps.name: World of Warcraft 1.12 (private server)
apps.how: Bring your client folder with Move my stuff (or let orion-games find it on the Windows drive), then run: orion-wow-client setup. It runs in Bottles and points realmlist.wtf at your own server.

apps.name: World of Warcraft (retail or Classic)
apps.how: Lutris installs Battle.net with its official install script, then Battle.net installs (or finds) the game. Set up: orion-games (or Settings > Games). It generally works under Wine but can break after a game update.

apps.name: Visual Studio Code
apps.how: VS Code has a Linux version (Microsoft's own package).

apps.name: Visual Studio
apps.how: Visual Studio is Windows-only. VS Code or JetBrains Rider cover most projects; Windows-only C# projects stay on Windows.

apps.name: Cursor
apps.how: Cursor has an official Linux version (AppImage or .deb) at cursor.com/downloads.

apps.name: Antigravity
apps.how: Google Antigravity has an official Linux download at antigravity.google.

apps.name: Claude
apps.how: Use Claude at claude.ai in the browser. Claude Code runs on Linux in the terminal.

apps.name: ChatGPT
apps.how: Use ChatGPT in the browser.

apps.name: Microsoft Office
apps.how: Use Office on the web (office.com) with your Microsoft account. LibreOffice on OrionOS opens and saves Word, Excel and PowerPoint files.

apps.name: Microsoft Outlook
apps.how: Use Outlook on the web, or Thunderbird for any mail account.

apps.name: Microsoft Teams
apps.how: Use Teams in the browser.

apps.name: OneDrive
apps.how: Use OneDrive in the browser. Move my stuff copies the files that are on this PC.

apps.name: Adobe Photoshop
apps.how: No Linux version. Krita (installed for you) or GIMP, or Photopea in the browser, cover most work; PSD files open in them.

apps.name: Adobe Illustrator
apps.how: No Linux version. Inkscape is the closest.

apps.name: Adobe Premiere Pro
apps.how: No Linux version. Kdenlive, or DaVinci Resolve (has a Linux version), are the closest.

apps.name: Adobe After Effects
apps.how: No Linux version and no close replacement.

apps.name: Adobe Lightroom
apps.how: No Linux version. darktable is the closest.

apps.name: Adobe Creative Cloud
apps.how: Adobe's apps don't run on Linux.

apps.name: Adobe Acrobat
apps.how: PDFs open on OrionOS. Okular also fills in forms and signs.

apps.name: OBS Studio
apps.how: OBS has a Linux version.

apps.name: Spotify
apps.how: Spotify has a Linux version.

apps.name: VLC

apps.name: Oracle VirtualBox
apps.how: On OrionOS, virtual machines use KVM, which is built into Linux (virt-manager). orion-boardroom-vm moves the boardroom VM over.

apps.name: VMware Workstation
apps.how: VMware has a Linux version, but KVM (virt-manager) is built in and simpler.

apps.name: Docker Desktop
apps.how: OrionOS has Podman, which runs the same containers.

apps.name: MySQL Workbench
apps.how: MySQL Workbench has an official Ubuntu package at dev.mysql.com. DBeaver (one click) works too.

apps.name: MySQL Server

apps.name: HeidiSQL
apps.how: Runs in Bottles, or use DBeaver.
